tasks.check: deno task --cwd apps/mobile check && deno task --cwd apps/portal check
tasks.build: deno task --cwd apps/mobile build && deno task --cwd apps/portal build
tasks.api: cargo run -q -p quest --bin quest -- openapi > crates/quest/openapi.json && deno run -A --node-modules-dir npm:openapi-typescript crates/quest/openapi.json -o apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts && cp apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts apps/portal/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts && treefmt crates/quest/openapi.json apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts apps/portal/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
tasks.api:check: deno task api && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- crates/quest/openapi.json apps/mobile/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts apps/portal/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts)"
